import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GaloisDescent.PicEtGaloisBridge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtDescentRepresentability

/-! Probe 1 (ajc-p3 r6): is the open-immersion half of hcov free? -/

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits
open scoped TensorProduct

-- LIVE-ENVIRONMENT CONTROL (I-1057): must report sorryAx.
#print axioms AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability

namespace Probe

universe u

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {k' : Type u} [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
  [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']

open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PicScheme

#check @AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.etale_pullback_fst_specMap

-- Q1: is the underlying scheme map of coverMap étale, by synthesis?
example (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    Etale (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T).left := by
  rw [coverMap_left]
  exact etale_pullback_fst_specMap (k := k) k' T.left T.hom

-- Q2: is the diagonal of that an open immersion?
example (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    IsOpenImmersion (pullback.diagonal (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T).left) := by
  haveI : Etale (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T).left := by
    rw [coverMap_left]; exact etale_pullback_fst_specMap (k := k) k' T.left T.hom
  infer_instance

-- Q3: is twistTest an isomorphism?
example (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    IsIso (twistTest (k' := k') T γ) := by
  exact?

end Probe
